meta_description: Bracebridge Tree Surgeons deliver expert tree care across Birmingham and Sutton Coldfield. Professional pruning, felling, and stump removal. Free quotes.
hero_subhead: Overgrown branches threatening your home? Bracebridge removes, prunes, and maintains trees safely across Birmingham and Sutton Coldfield.
services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery Services Across Birmingham
services_subhead: From emergency storm damage to routine maintenance, we handle every aspect of professional tree care with safety and precision.

services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe, controlled removal of large or hazardous trees, including those in confined spaces. We manage all waste and leave your garden clear and level.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Pruning
services.desc: Thin and shape branches to restore light, reduce wind resistance, and improve tree health. Ideal for overgrown specimens near buildings or power lines.

services.title: Stump Grinding
services.desc: Remove stumps flush with the ground using professional grinding equipment. Prevents regrowth and reclaims valuable garden space.

services.title: Storm Damage Response
services.desc: Emergency callout for fallen or dangerous branches. We make trees safe and restore access within 48 hours, 7 days a week.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Management
services.desc: Keep boundary hedges neat, healthy, and compliant with local regulations. Regular cutting encourages dense, attractive growth.

services.title: Arboricultural Surveys
services.desc: Professional assessment of tree health, risk, and preservation value. Reports guide planning permission applications and insurance claims.

about_pullquote: We treat your garden like we'd treat our own — careful, honest, and always safe.
about_para_1: Bracebridge Tree Surgeons has been caring for trees and gardens across Birmingham and Sutton Coldfield for over two decades. Founded on a passion for safe, skilled arboriculture, we've built our reputation by completing hundreds of jobs to the highest standard—from major felling to delicate pruning in tight spaces.
about_para_2: Our team holds NPTC qualifications and follows strict health and safety protocols on every job. We're not just here to cut trees; we want you to understand why work is needed and what the benefits will be. Customers return to us because we're honest, efficient, and genuinely care about protecting your property and the environment.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a massive oak threatening our fence and house. Bracebridge came out, explained everything clearly, and took it down safely in a day. Tidied up perfectly. Couldn't ask for better service. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Storm brought down part of our sycamore and we were worried it'd damage the extension. Called Bracebridge and they got out the same day. Quick, professional, no faffing about. Very reasonable price too.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Needed three conifers thinned to let light back into the garden. The lads were polite, explained what they were doing, and the job was done in 4 hours. Waste was cleared straight away. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Paul W.
